name: selfhost-cell-loop
formats: Every string below is matched literally by the acceptance suite, so match it exactly. Status members have the lowercase values `complete`, `capped`, `infrastructure` and `interrupted`, and Slot.name is the index as two digits (`03`). plan_slots gives slot i the arm arms[i % len(arms)], n slots per arm. INFRASTRUCTURE_CODES is WORKSPACE_FAILED, CLEANUP_FAILED, GRADE_FAILED, TRANSCRIPT_MISSING, TRANSCRIPT_EMPTY, MODEL_ERROR and PATCH_INVALID; every other code (OK, NO_PATCH, COMMAND_TIMEOUT, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, REPEAT_LIMIT) is a model outcome and never stops the night. infrastructure_reason(result) returns `slot <NN> (<arm>): <code>: <message>` for an infrastructure code, `slot <NN> (<arm>): DEADLINE_EXCEEDED in <deadline_phase>: <message>` for DEADLINE_EXCEEDED whose deadline_phase is not `command`, and None otherwise (for example `slot 03 (engine): DEADLINE_EXCEEDED in grading: m`). A cell writes its result to slot_path(night, slot), `<night>/slots/<NN>.json`; read_slots returns only files named exactly `<NN>.json`, keyed by int index. launch_cells: finished slots (those with a result file) never run again; at the start of a launch each finished slot whose result has an infrastructure reason is renamed to `<NN>.replaced-<M>.json` (M counts from 1), appended to outcome.replaced as its result plus a `replaced_because` key holding the reason, and runs again. Pending slots start in index order while fewer than k run; call drift() immediately before each spawn, and a non-None answer stops the night with status infrastructure and reason `preflight drift: <answer>`. A slot starts only when (clock() - launch start) + cell_seconds is not greater than max_seconds; otherwise nothing new starts, running cells finish, and when slots remain the status is capped with a reason containing `<count> slot(s) wait` (count is the slots not started). Poll running cells each tick, sleeping poll_interval between ticks; a cell that exits appends its result dict to outcome.finished in the order cells finish. The first infrastructure result stops the night: status infrastructure, reason from infrastructure_reason, no new slot starts, and running cells are left to finish. A cell process that exits with no result file stops the night with the reason `slot <NN> (<arm>): the cell process exited <exit code> without an attempt record`. A clean finish is status complete with reason None. SignalAbort or KeyboardInterrupt raised anywhere in the loop (including from sleep) is never re-raised: call terminate() once on each running cell, poll until they exit or grace seconds pass on clock, call kill() only on cells still running, and return status interrupted with a reason containing the exception's type name. write_ledger writes `<night>/launch.json`: on first write the identity keys plus `sittings: []` and `replaced: []`; each call appends to sittings the sitting dict plus `status` and `reason` (and an `ended` timestamp), extends replaced with outcome.replaced, sets top-level `status` and `reason`, and sets `slots` to every finished slot result in index order. check_night(night, identity) does nothing when there is no ledger and raises UsageError containing `belongs to another record` when any identity key's value differs from the ledger's.
